description: Read one DMARC aggregate (RUA) report, the XML a receiver sends to the rua= address, pasted as text (decompress a .xml.gz first). Returns who reported and when (analysis.report), the policy the domain published (analysis.policy), message totals and the split into DMARC-capable, forwarded (SPF failed, DKIM aligned) and unauthenticated (both failed) mail, every source row with its IP, count, disposition, SPF/DKIM alignment and the sending provider when known (analysis.records, up to 500), and the recommendations the /dmarc-report page shows (analysis.recommendations). `verdict` is unauthenticated_mail, clean or empty_report. Findings: DMARC_REPORT_UNAUTH_NOT_ENFORCED (error: unauthenticated mail under p=none), DMARC_REPORT_UNAUTH_QUARANTINED, DMARC_REPORT_POLICY_UNKNOWN, DMARC_REPORT_LOW_COMPLIANCE, DMARC_REPORT_SP_WEAKER, DMARC_REPORT_RECORDS_SKIPPED (warn), DMARC_REPORT_FORWARDED, DMARC_REPORT_PCT_PARTIAL, DMARC_REPORT_EMPTY (info). A report reflects what receivers saw; check the live record with check_dmarc. Input that is not a <feedback> document, declares a DOCTYPE or is oversize returns the non-retriable INPUT_INVALID error. The echoed `input` is the byte count only; the report is parsed in server memory, not cached and not stored. Read-only.

report.description: One DMARC aggregate (RUA) report as XML text, starting at <?xml or <feedback>. A .xml.gz or .zip attachment must be decompressed first.

name: analyze_dmarc_report
